candidate_relations.reason: Although oral and vaginal ulcers resemble Behçet disease, the monomorphic atypical CD3-positive T-cell infiltrates, abnormal CD52-positive T-cell population, splenomegaly, and lymphadenopathy support T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia as the final diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Inflammatory clinical mimic based on mucosal and cutaneous ulcerations, not the underlying hematologic malignancy.
